name: TOB Bible Battle Queue
description: Server-side matchmaking queue row, one per player currently searching for an opponent. Exists as its own doctype (beyond the core Battle/Answer/Rating set) specifically so matchmaking has persistent, row-lockable state for race-safe opponent claiming (see truth_of_bible.games.bible_battle.matchmaking) rather than relying on in-memory/cache state. System-Manager-only permissions; players only ever touch this through start_matchmaking/cancel_matchmaking/get_match_status.

fields.label: BIR Snapshot
fields.description: The player's BIR at the moment they joined the queue — cached so matchmaking doesn't re-read Rating on every scan, and so tolerance widening is computed against a stable baseline.
